prompt:
Illustration for a collectible Digimon trading card showing Ikkakumon.
The attached image is a reference sheet of the 3D game model in three-quarter view. They are low-polygon PlayStation models: keep each design EXACTLY (proportions, head shape, eyes, claws, colours and markings). The attached image is a render of the real in-game 3D model of the character. USE THIS EXACT CHARACTER as the subject: copy its DESIGN faithfully, with its identical faceted low-polygon shapes, proportions, pixel-art texture details, colours, markings, eyes and claws. The reference shows the model in a neutral rest pose: do NOT copy that pose, re-pose the character freely. Do not redesign, smooth, round off or re-draw it in another style: it must look like the same model, only now standing inside the scene, lit consistently with it and casting a soft shadow on the ground. Only the scene around it is yours to paint, and the scene MUST be in the SAME visual style as the character: a late-1990s PlayStation 3D game environment made of flat-shaded low-polygon facets with small pixelated texture maps, blocky angular rocks, trees and terrain, plain colour areas, crisp edges. NOT a painting: no brush strokes, no soft airbrushed gradients, no glow, no sparks or embers, no smoke, no fog, no bokeh, no glossy or wet surfaces. The character must look native to the scene, as if both were rendered by the same game engine. The character fills about 60% of the image height, with the scene visible around it.
Pose: striking a heroic pose in strict side profile, full body visible from head to feet. Setting: a frozen lake with blocky ice floes, late-1990s low-poly look, painterly and colourful, with depth behind the creature and a clear single subject.
Composition: the creature centred, filling about 70% of the height, with comfortable margins on every side (the card crops the edges). Soft, even light. No light beams, no god rays, no haze, no glare.
Strictly: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no card frame, no UI. Square image.
reference: 3D model reference sheet of each species (cardmaker.py ref)
